parsing.acceptedInput: the whole canonical token; no whitespace trimming or case folding

ordering.sameCore: next < dev < rcN < final < vendor final < numeric micro < letter patch
ordering.development: a missing dev number precedes numeric dev numbers
ordering.patch: bijective base-26 lowercase ordinal: a=1, z=26, aa=27
